usage.finalMessage:
I've done CLIN-23-R1: `prescribe` now refuses a dose above the formulary maximum and refuses drugs not in the formulary. All 7 tests in `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` pass, and the work is committed.
CLIN-23 is not complete, though: R2 needs Pharmacy to check the doses in `src/Clinic/Rules.fs` against `docs/formulary.md` and record that in `docs/verification/` before release. I didn't write that record because it isn't mine to make.
Drug names must match the formulary exactly in lowercase, so "Ibuprofen" is refused; I've asked Pharmacy whether that should change, and both questions are in `.work/report.json`.

OUTCOME: completed
